result:
Both gates pass: `bun run typecheck` is clean and `bun test` runs 9 tests across 3 files with 0 failures.

I added a public JSON feed at `GET /api/posts`, named `api.posts.index`. A new `routes/api.ts` holds the registrar (called from `routes/web.ts` next to `registerAuthRoutes`, so it sits outside the `auth` groups and stays unauthenticated); the route declares its contract inline — `query: ApiListPostsQuerySchema` (a new schema in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`: `page` a positive int defaulting to 1, `author` an optional positive int, both `z.coerce`d since query values arrive as strings) and `resource: { data: [PostResource] }`, matching how `posts.search` types its response. The router enforces the query schema before the controller runs, so `?page=0`, `?page=abc`, `?author=abc` and `?author=0` all return 422 with the standard `{ message, errors }` JSON body. `PostController.apiIndex` reads the parsed values via `validateQuery`, then uses `Post.withPaginate('author', …)` — the QueryBuilder's `paginate()` silently skips eager loading, so a `.with('author').paginate()` chain would have dropped the author from every row — ordered by `createdAt desc, id desc`, 10 per page, filtered by `authorId` when `author` is given, and returns `{ data: PostResource rows, meta, links }` where `meta` carries `currentPage`, `lastPage`, `perPage`, `total` (plus `from`/`to`). Codegen was re-run, so `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` now exposes `'api.posts.index'` with `response: { data: Array<Data.Post> }`. New DB-backed coverage lives in `tests/ApiPostController.test.ts` (ordering, page size, second page, author filter, filter+page combined, empty author, the invalid-parameter 422s, and the no-session case). I left the pre-existing `PostController.index` page route untouched even though it has the same eager-loading gap, since the task asks that existing pages keep behaving as they do now.
